Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: editorial architectural illustration inside a premium real estate agency website's mortgage planning card.
Primary request: a beautifully crafted detailed miniature apartment architectural model, open roof cutaway, elevated three-quarter axonometric camera, as a tangible metaphor for a clear plan and a future home.
Subject: one compact contemporary two-bedroom apartment on a precise thin rectangular architectural plinth. Coherent living room with sofa and round coffee table, kitchen and small dining table, bedroom with a neatly made bed, a second smaller room, a small bathroom, glazed balcony. Readable partition walls and door openings. Finely modeled mullions, cabinetry, layered textiles, a single small indoor plant. The model should be warm and desirable, sophisticated rather than toy-like.
Style/medium: exceptionally refined physical architectural scale-model photography / restrained 3D editorial render. Matte warm ivory walls, pale limestone, tiny light-oak accents, frosted glazing. Delicate cyan #57C4ED on one translucent window plane and a few blueprint-like construction lines at the base. No saturated furniture.
Composition: landscape 3:2 image; complete model centered, occupying 85 percent of image width, all sides fully visible with breathing room; camera tilted down about 45 degrees, straight verticals, no exaggerated perspective. Soft seamless sage-off-white studio backdrop matching #EDF0E9 at all four edges. Subtle contact shadow grounds the object; no dramatic cast shadows.
Lighting: broad diffused daylight, tactile surfaces, crisp fine details, gentle ambient occlusion, calm editorial art direction.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no icons, no people, no oversized key, no coins, no arrows, no surrounding stationery, no dark outline, no cartoon bevels. This is a conceptual illustration, not an actual listing floor plan. Generate at high resolution.
